purpose: Teach: 宮内/市況/愛さ/べし/つた/こく/まぜ/混ざっ

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お味の濃くなった煮物、お客様に伝った、絶対お気に入りです。当社、宮内に関係する事業も検討しましょう
lines.en: The richer-flavored simmered dishes we've made are already beloved by our clients. Let's explore business opportunities tied to Imperial heritage as well.
lines.style: Measured executive tone. Forward momentum on each clause. Slight pause before the pivot to expansion. Confident but inviting input.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市況の変動に注意しております
lines.en: Yes. We're keeping a close eye on market fluctuations.
lines.style: Attentive and grounded. Brief pause before the second sentence—showing he's actively monitoring. Calm, steady assurance.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お客様に愛される商品を作りましょう
lines.en: Let's create products that customers truly love.
lines.style: Gentle emphasis on "truly." Open, inclusive phrasing. Warm but clear direction. Not commanding—inviting collaboration.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様目線で考えるべしですね
lines.en: You're right. We should think from the customer's perspective.
lines.style: Thoughtful agreement. Small nod in the voice before speaking. Reflective—he's taking the direction inward. Sincere buy-in.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員に伝えるべしの理念を整理しましょう
lines.en: Let's organize and communicate the core values we want our team to live by.
lines.style: Steady directive. Slight weight on "organize"—getting structure right matters. Professional but not distant. Collaborative framing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。先輩が築かれた信頼を引き継ぐべく頑張ります
lines.en: Yes. I'm committed to carrying forward the trust you've built here.
lines.style: Respectful, grounded tone. Slight emphasis on "trust"—he feels the weight of it. Sincere without being effusive. Measured dedication.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: チーム間で人材をまぜて新発想を生みましょう
lines.en: Let's mix talent across teams and spark new ideas.
lines.style: Lighter, energized tone. Quick pace on "mix talent." Forward-looking, almost excited but professional. Inviting rather than demanding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。部署が混ざったプロジェクトを立てます
lines.en: Understood. I'll put together a cross-departmental project team.
lines.style: Efficient and assured. Crisp on the opening. Quiet confidence—he's already thinking about logistics. Ready to move forward.
